Fully Upgraded 5-Bedroom Villa | Smart Home | Biggest Plot in Meadows 5

A rare opportunity to own one of the most exceptional villas in Meadows 5. This fully upgraded 5-bedroom villa sits on an expansive 8,670 sq.ft plot — one of the largest in the community — and features premium finishes, smart technology, and a private pool, making it a true standout in Dubai’s villa market.

Key Property Details:

Location: Meadows 5
Plot Size: 8,670 sq.ft
BUA: 3,700 sq.ft
Configuration: 5 Bedrooms including a Royal Master Suite
Finishing: Premium marble imported from Italy & Iran
Status: Vacant / Occupied (please update as needed)

Features & Upgrades:

Fully renovated throughout with modern, high-end interiors
Smart Home System with integrated security, lighting, and climate control
Private swimming pool and beautifully landscaped garden
Spacious living and dining areas with open-plan layout
Royal Master Suite with luxurious en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet
Covered parking, maid’s room, and ample storage

Community Highlights:

Gated community with 24/7 security
Lush green parks, lakes, and walking trails
Community swimming pools, tennis courts, and children’s play areas
Close to top international schools, supermarkets, and Sheikh Zayed Road

This home offers the perfect blend of space, elegance, and smart living — ideal for families or investors seeking premium property in a prime location.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
